body.name: Bounded binary-covariate strict-gain family
body.construction: Set \(T=3\), \(\mathcal K=\{(2,2),(2,3)\}\), \(\mathcal J_{(2,2)}=\{3,\infty\}\), and \(\mathcal J_{(2,3)}=\{\infty\}\). Draw \(X\) uniformly on \(\{-1,1\}\), and draw \((G,S)\) uniformly on \(\{2,3,\infty\}\times\{0,1\}\) conditional on \(X\). Conditional on \(X=x\) and \(G=a\), draw \((U^{\mathrm w},V^{\mathrm w})\in\{-1,1\}^2\) with probability \(\{1+\rho_a(x)U^{\mathrm w}V^{\mathrm w}\}/4\), where \(\rho_2(x)=\rho_3(x)=0\) and \(\rho_{\infty}(x)=xr\). Put \(Z^{\mathrm w}=(0,U^{\mathrm w}/8,V^{\mathrm w}/8)^{\prime}\), define \(Y_t(a,s)=Z_t^{\mathrm w}+\delta s\mathbf 1\{a<\infty\}\mathbf 1\{t\ge a\}\), and set \(Y_t=Y_t(G,S)\). The resulting full-data law is \(Q^{\mathrm{bin}}_{r,\delta}\).
